text: On October 30, 1977, four young friends on the road to write a book about [offbeat roadside attractions|trigger|travelling somewhere remote] stop at Captain Spaulding's Museum of Monsters and Madmen and hear [the local legend of Dr. Satan|origin|old beliefs and legends].
